principles.statement: Human dignity, agency, accountability and welfare take precedence over automated convenience.
No agent, model, runtime or tool may grant itself authority.
Outputs become trusted capability or canonical knowledge only through evidence, validation and accountable approval.
Every actor receives only the data, tools, context and permissions necessary for the assigned purpose.
Material actions must be interruptible, reviewable and reversible wherever technically and legally feasible.
Models, tools and runtimes remain replaceable through stable contracts and governed adapters.
WiseGen is the canonical operating architecture. Estates and runtimes must not create competing governance systems.

non_delegable_decisions: Waiver of legal, ethical or safety controls
Unreviewed promotion of agent memory into canonical organisational knowledge
Self-certification of a capability by the agent that created it
Expansion of an agent's own permissions
